# IAssetModeler

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Output` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public interface IAssetModeler
```

Turns one finished asset into 3D model files. Lives in Core so [`SetWriter`](Nfty.Core.Output.SetWriter.md) needn't know any model library; the CLI supplies the implementation.

## Properties

### Options { #p-options }

```csharp
public abstract SetModels Options { get; }
```

The options the models are made with, recorded in `set.json`. Its [`SetModels.Skipped`](Nfty.Core.Output.SetModels.md#p-skipped) is ignored here; the writer fills it in.

## Methods

### FileNames(string) { #m-filenames-system-string }

```csharp
public abstract IReadOnlyList<string> FileNames(string baseName);
```

Every file name [`IAssetModeler.Model()`](Nfty.Core.Output.IAssetModeler.md#m-model-nfty-core-generation-generatedasset-system-string) may return for an asset, derivable without building any model. The writer validates these for the whole Set before writing anything, then refuses a model file whose name was not declared here.

**Parameters**

- `baseName` (`string`) - The asset's zero-padded number.

**Returns.** The bare file names.

### Model(GeneratedAsset, string) { #m-model-nfty-core-generation-generatedasset-system-string }

```csharp
public abstract IReadOnlyList<SetFile>? Model(GeneratedAsset asset, string baseName);
```

Files for one asset, named from `baseName` (`"0007"` becomes `"0007.glb"`), or null when nothing in it is fully opaque. Called concurrently for different assets, so it must be a pure function of its input.

**Parameters**

- `asset` (`GeneratedAsset`) - The finished asset.
- `baseName` (`string`) - The asset's zero-padded number.

**Returns.** The files, or null when the asset cannot be modeled.
